app.preferences.security.title: Security
app.preferences.security.password.title: Password
app.preferences.security.password.desc: The password you sign in with. Changing it requires your current password.
app.preferences.security.password.disabl: Signing in with a password has been turned off by the administrator. Use a code sent to your email address or a passkey instead.
app.preferences.security.totp.title: Two-Step Verification
app.preferences.security.totp.desc: After your password, sign-in also asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, and others).
app.preferences.security.totp.setupStep1: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key by hand.
app.preferences.security.totp.setupStep2: 2. Enter the code the app shows now.
app.preferences.security.totp.confirmPas: Enter your current password to set up two-step verification.
app.preferences.security.totp.disableMes: Your account will be protected by your password alone. The authenticator app entry and your backup codes stop working. Enter your current password to continue.

app.preferences.security.backupCodes.int: Each code signs you in once when you cannot use your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe; they are not shown again.
app.preferences.security.backupCodes.fil:
Backup codes for {username}
Each code can be used once. Generated {date}.
app.preferences.security.passkeys.title: Passkeys
app.preferences.security.passkeys.desc: Sign in without a password using your device's face or fingerprint recognition, its PIN, or a security key. A passkey replaces both the password and the verification code.
app.preferences.security.passkeys.unavai: Passkeys are not configured on this server.

app.preferences.linked.title: Linked accounts
app.preferences.linked.desc: Link your Google or Microsoft account so apps can use it, such as Mail with your Gmail or Outlook mailbox. Each app asks for a permission only when it needs one, and you can take any of them back here.
app.preferences.linked.none: This appears once an administrator enables account linking on this server.
app.preferences.linked.unlinkMessage: Every permission granted to this Webtop by your {provider} account is given up. Apps that rely on it (such as a mail account signed in with it) stop working until you link again. Continue?
app.preferences.linked.revokeMessage: The Webtop stops using "{bundle}" of your {provider} account. Apps that rely on it ask again when they need it. Continue?
app.preferences.linked.bundle.mail.desc: The Mail app reads and sends mail of this account over IMAP and SMTP.
app.preferences.linked.bundle.files.desc: Open your Drive or OneDrive in the Content Browser, copy files between it and the workspace, attach them to mail and save files there.
app.preferences.linked.bundle.calendar.d: Show your events and add invitations to your calendar.
